evidence.detail: The class defines the exact 24-skill lowercase name array from attack through summoning and a parallel 24-entry display-name/widget-id table, including Construction, Hunter and Summoning.
Client sizes multiple live skill arrays from rs/f/e.a, consults rs/f/e.d when aggregating skill state, and resolves the per-skill widget id through rs/f/e.c during skill presentation/update logic.
The live rs/s/h/a SkillLevelChanged event bridge indexes rs/f/e.b by skillId to derive the skill name used for notification/presentation behavior.
The class has no rendering loop, packet decoding, mutable gameplay service or independent lifecycle; its role is static skill indexing/naming/presentation metadata shared by multiple consumers.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the shared 24-skill metadata/index table. It is distinct from R275 SkillsInterface, which owns the visible skill-tab UI.
